summary: Build evidence-based culture diagnostics, psychological safety actions, and change roadmaps in this advanced five-day course. Enquire today.
lede: Positive workplace culture training helps HR partners, people managers and organizational development professionals turn culture evidence into practical interventions. They practise assessing survey, interview and listening evidence, mapping behaviours to stated values, and designing psychological safety actions, culture indicators and executive reports so findings can guide priorities and follow-up.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is for professionals who already influence people practices, organizational behaviour, employee experience, or culture change and now need a disciplined method for turning evidence into action.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in organizational development, human resources, employee experience, people management, change management, inclusion, or people analytics. Familiarity with employee surveys, leadership development, or workplace culture initiatives will help you contribute to advanced case work. No coding or programming is required. AI-assisted sentiment analysis is addressed at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
